text:
Ivy N: flagging a small thread for the 2.19.0 internal note. aiming to post internal blast at 17:10 PT. need final wording on pinline + rollforward/rollback rules.
Theo R: dropping the draft now. i'll add artifact SHAs and the exact rbinctl example.
Docs Sam: PR: https://phab/repo/PR-5038 (internal note + rundown). i've trimmed customer bullets to a one-line.
deploy-bot: preflight ok, staging snapshot created snap-2026-03-23-1642. quiet-mode target #eng-oncall.
oncall-lucy: i'll be on rotation 16:50-19:00; please include a clear "who can flip the switch" line.
Ivy N: put pinline wording like: "Pinned release: 2.19.0 — model pinning applied to hosted + dedicated. Private customers: advisory email." keep short.
Theo R: inserted commands into PR: ```
# pin model artifacts
rbinctl pin --env=prod --model=rdw-main --hash=deadbeef0011
rbinctl pin --env=prod --model=rdw-quant --hash=feedface2233
# emergency kill-switch (oncall only)
rbinctl traffic --env=prod --set-canary=0
```
Docs Sam: added grafana link for quick watch: https://grafana/boards/deploy-2-19-0 and a checklist in the runbook.
Ivy N: rollback shorthand for the internal note: "If ANY of: 5m error rate >=2% OR P95 token latency +45% OR >=2 failed smoke tests => set canary=0 and notify #eng-oncall. If TWO thresholds met, start SEV-lite and call owners." full playbook in PR.
oncall-lucy: suggest adding a short wait-after-zero: "wait 4m after canary=0 to validate metrics before full rollforward/rollback". i'll be ready to trigger kill-switch.
Theo R: canary plan proposed: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> full. adding note: if memory pressure observed, hold ramp and consult release lead.
Ivy N: timeline: 15:00 ops needs final copy, 15:40 hashes locked, 16:50 oncall confirmed, 17:10 deploy window. can we hit that?
Theo R: yes, i'll lock SHAs by 15:40 and paste final copy here by 15:10 for quick dev lint.
Docs Sam: one-liner for deploy-bot (short): "Deploy 2.19.0 to hosted/dedicated. Canary 5% -> 25% -> full. Rollback rules in internal note."
deploy-bot: deploy window scheduled 17:10-18:10 PT. will post announce to #eng at 17:15.
Theo R: final copy pasted below and pushed to PR.
```
Internal announce: Releasing 2.19.0 at 17:10 PT. Highlights: batching perf tweaks, model pin UI, and small console fixes. Canary: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> full. Rollback: set canary=0 on ANY of: 5m error rate >=2% OR P95 latency +45% OR >=2 failed smoke tests; wait 4m after canary=0 to validate. If TWO thresholds met, start SEV-lite and escalate. Owners: Ivy N (PM), Theo R (Release Eng), Lucy (Oncall). Model hashes and pin commands: rdw-main@sha256:deadbeef0011, rdw-quant@sha256:feedface2233. Runbook & PR: https://phab/repo/PR-5038.
```
oncall-lucy: standing by 16:50-19:00. will monitor token_latency.p95, inference.errors/5m, model_mem. kill-switch readiness confirmed.
Ivy N: final checklist: (1) ops receives final copy by 15:00 (Docs Sam), (2) hashes locked by 15:40 (Theo), (3) oncall standby confirmed (Lucy), (4) deploybot scheduled (done). i'll post internal blast at 17:15 with the one-liner. thanks team :rocket:
